author: T2 (sole engine writer / build owner)

engine.project: ScummVM (Ultima VIII: Pagan, engine id ultima8)
engine.canonical_contract_note: .scratch/contracts is read-only in the worker sandbox (EPERM); this worktree copy is authoritative until the host copies it to the canonical path.

design_rules: JS entry points only ENQUEUE work or READ cached state; they never re-enter a mutating engine object while Asyncify has the wasm suspended.
All commands are drained by the engine at the frame boundary (Ultima8Engine::handleDelayedEvents -> ultima8BridgeProcessFrame).
Engine events (custom engine actions, mouse) are enqueued through Common::EventManager::pushEvent and drained by the normal per-frame pollEvent loop.
The queue is bounded; overflow is counted and dropped, never blocked.

readiness.returns: 1 once the engine has an initialised world/avatar; 0 before. Poll from JS; do not call other exports before it returns 1.

binding_semantics.movement: 8-way = hold MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT (30-33); diagonals hold two actions; always-run is MOVE_RUN (34).
binding_semantics.attack: U8 has NO attack key. ATTACK(36) is CRUSADER-ONLY and MUST NOT be emitted for ultima8. U8 attack = left-button double-click over target.
binding_semantics.block: U8 block = hold left button; release ends block.
binding_semantics.use: world object left double-click; look single left click; move middle click; pick-up = left drag.
binding_semantics.note: A double-click needs two real button-downs separated by real frame time inside the window; never emit two down/up pairs inside a single poll.

speed.enforcement: Bridge forces _animationRate=100 (1.0x) while in combat or in Classic mode, regardless of the requested multiplier; Modern out-of-combat applies the multiplier.

exports.int _bridge_push_event(int type, int a,: enqueue one Common::Event. mouse: a=x,b=y; custom action: a=action; key: a=keycode,b=ascii,c=flags. Returns 1 accepted / 0 rejected.
exports.int _bridge_set_speed(double multiplier): set Modern travel multiplier (clamped 0.25..4); 0 if not finite.
exports.int _bridge_gesture(int kind, int x, int: enqueue a timed U8 pointer gesture; hold=1 press/start, hold=0 release (block). Returns 1/0.
exports.int _bridge_read_state(int field): return the cached int for state_fields (refreshed every frame). No engine re-entry.
exports.int _bridge_get_name_ptr(): pointer to UTF8 avatar name (valid until next frame).
exports.int _bridge_export_save(int slot): read save slot via SaveFileManager into a bridge buffer; returns pointer (0 on failure).
exports.int _bridge_export_size(): byte length of the last successful export.
exports.int _bridge_alloc(int size): malloc for import payload; returns pointer.
exports.int _bridge_import_save(int slot, int pt: write ptr[0..size) as the save slot file via SaveFileManager; returns 1/0.
exports.void _bridge_emit_event(int type, int a,: combat event publisher hook (see engine_event_stream). E1 has no call sites (harmless no-op).

engine_event_stream.status: LIVE in E2 (combat + real save/load completion). Types 1-6 unchanged from the frozen E1 interface; 7-8 are the additive v1.1 delta.
engine_event_stream.purpose: shell feedback for the upcoming combat patch (E2): hit / block / hurt / death.
engine_event_stream.transport: C++ ModernCombat sink -> enqueue (engine thread) -> drained once per frame -> Module.bridgeOnEngineEvent(type,a,b,c,d,frame). Serial save/load results are enqueued from the CMD_SAVE/CMD_LOAD drain.
engine_event_stream.js_hook: Module.bridgeOnEngineEvent = (type, a, b, c, d, frame) => { ... }

args.note: Additive v1.1: the L2 EventSink payload is (name,a0,a1,a2,a3); all four ints are forwarded faithfully as (a,b,c,d). `frame` is the real kernel frame at emission.
args.a: primary actor/objId (for HIT the attacker; for BLOCK/HURT/DEATH the target)

engine_event_stream.js_hook_additive: The hook signature is additive: E1 consumers written as (type,a,b,c) keep working; d (4th L2 payload int) and frame (Kernel::getFrameNum(), 30 Hz tick) are appended args.
engine_event_stream.attack_events_boundary: ATTACK_START/ATTACK_END are emitted by ActorAnimProcess at the real attack/kick animation start (init) and end (terminate), never at the input gesture. Enabled by FLAG_ATTACK_EVENTS in BOTH Modern and Classic (instrumentation only; no gameplay change) so attack-press->animation-start latency is measurable per profile.

save_semantics.persistence: IDBFS mounted at HOME with autoPersist; bridge also calls FS.syncfs after save/import.
save_semantics.export_import: byte-exact save file round-trip via SaveFileManager; hash-stable.
save_semantics.queued_not_saved: Ultima8Bridge.save(slot) only ENQUEUES CMD_SAVE (returns 1 = queued). The engine performs the write at the next frame boundary (Ultima8Engine::handleDelayedEvents); the return value is NOT proof the file was written. Poll snapshot().WORLD_X stability or re-export to confirm the slot exists.
save_semantics.syncfs_async: The C++ _bridge_syncfs() returns 1 synchronously while FS.syncfs(false, cb) is still in flight; its callback is currently empty, so a queued save/import is NOT durable-to-IndexedDB when that call returns.
save_semantics.durable_completion: Additive (JS-only) Ultima8Bridge.flushPersist() -> Promise<boolean> resolves against the REAL FS.syncfs completion callback; await it when UI durability (survives reload) is required. It does not fabricate a save result, only a persistence flush result.
save_semantics.save_failure_visibility: RESOLVED in E2 (additive): CMD_SAVE/CMD_LOAD capture the real Common::Error and enqueue SAVE_RESULT(7)/LOAD_RESULT(8) with ok=1 only on kNoError. The shell must still not treat save()==1 (enqueue) as success; wait for SAVE_RESULT ok==1 AND await flushPersist() for durability.

runtime_notes.heap_views_not_on_module: On the real dist build the Emscripten typed-array views (HEAP8/HEAPU8/...) are top-level vars in scummvm.js and are NOT assigned to Module, so Module.HEAPU8 is undefined. The glue resolves the live view from Module.HEAPU8 if present, else the global HEAPU8.
runtime_notes.memory_growth_stale_views: updateMemoryViews() REPLACES the global view vars on every wasm memory growth (detaching the old ArrayBuffer). The glue re-resolves the current view at each call and never caches a view across an allocation. exportSave returns a JS copy (never a heap alias); importSave re-resolves after _bridge_alloc.
runtime_notes.no_fabricated_pass: exportSave returns null and importSave returns 0 when no live heap view / alloc is available; the glue never returns synthetic bytes or a fake success to satisfy a check.
runtime_notes.frame_counter_not_wallclock: _bridge_frame() counts render-loop passes (~84/s here), NOT the 30 Hz gameplay kernel tick. Never use it as a wall-clock gameplay-speed proxy; the only gameplay-speed lever is _bridge_set_speed / SPEED_RATE and it must be validated by world-delta over real time.

additive_js_facade.flushPersist: () => Promise<boolean> — await real IDBFS flush completion (see save_semantics.durable_completion). Added in the heap-access fix; the frozen v1 surface is otherwise unchanged.

v1_1_additive.status: ADDITIVE to the frozen v1; no frozen member changed.
v1_1_additive.kernel_frame_state: state_fields.KERNEL_FRAME=24 -> the actual 30 Hz Kernel::getFrameNum() tick (contrast FRAME=19, the ~84/s render-loop pass counter).
v1_1_additive.event_payload: Module.bridgeOnEngineEvent extended to (type,a,b,c,d,frame); existing (type,a,b,c) consumers unaffected.
v1_1_additive.canonical_note: .scratch/contracts is read-only in the worker sandbox; the host must copy this worktree copy (and the delta) to the canonical path.
